```plato
//==
// # Convex hulls
//
// The convex hull of a point set, kept together with the provenance of its
// vertices: which of the input points survived onto the hull, and in hull
// order. The provenance is what lets per-point attributes (colors, weights,
// labels) follow the geometry through a hull, which is lost the moment a hull
// is returned as bare geometry.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Convex_hull)
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding (hull boundaries are
// counter-clockwise as seen from outside, like every other loop here).

// The convex hull of a 2D point set: the bounding polygon, wound
// counter-clockwise, plus the index of the source point each hull vertex came
// from. SourceIndices is index-aligned with the polygon's own Points.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Convex_hull_algorithms)
// Instances come from ConvexHull (geometry.library.plato) or from a host.
type ConvexHull2D
    implements IValue
{
    Hull: Polygon2D;
    SourceIndices: Array<ItemIndex>;
}
```
